NOTE: Any field not included in the update request will be set to either an empty string or null in the database depending on the field definition. The recommended workflow to ensure no data is inadvertently overwritten is to execute a GET request for the resource you're about to update and then use this response to fill any of the fields that are not being updated. A PUT replaces the record, so read it first with get_association and send every field you want to keep.
update_association.notes: Buildium API key permission required: Associations > Associations and units - View Edit. Permissions are set per key in Buildium's Settings > Developer tools, not carried as scopes.

name.description: Association name. The value cannot exceed 127 characters.

description.description: Description of the association. The value cannot exceed 65,535 characters.

year_built.description: Indicates the year the association was established. If provided this value must be a four digit integer between 1000 and the current year.

operating_bank_account_id.description: The primary bank account that an association uses for its income and expenses.

reserve.description: A property reserve is cash that a property manager keeps on hand in case of unexpected expenses. It is available cash that isn't disbursed in an owner draw.

address.description: Association address. Fields: AddressLine1 (string, required); AddressLine2 (string); AddressLine3 (string); City (string); State (string); PostalCode (string, required); Country (string, required, one of Afghanistan/Akrotiri/Albania/Algeria/AmericanSamoa/Andorra/Angola/Anguilla/Antarctica/AntiguaandBarbuda/...).

property_manager_id.description: Indicates the staff member identifier that acts as the property manager for this association. Note, the staff member must have permissions to this association to be assigned as the property manager. Set this field to null if you don't want to assign a staff member to the association.

fiscal_year_end_day.description: The day the fiscal year ends for the association.

fiscal_year_end_month.description: The month the fiscal year ends for the association.

output.description: The record: Id, Name, IsActive, Reserve, Description, YearBuilt, OperatingBankAccount, OperatingBankAccountId, Address, AssociationManager, FiscalYearEndDay, FiscalYearEndMonth, TaxInformation.

IsActive.description: Indicates whether the association is active within the Buildium platform.

Reserve.description: A property reserve is cash that a property manager keeps on hand in case of unexpected expenses. It is available cash that simply isn't disbursed in an owner draw.

YearBuilt.description: Indicates the year the association was built. Null if no value is set.

OperatingBankAccount.description: Primary bank account that an association uses for its income and expenses.

OperatingBankAccountId.description: Primary bank account unique identifier that an association uses for its income and expenses.

AssociationManager.description: Property manager associated with this association.

FiscalYearEndDay.description: The day the fiscal year ends for the association.

FiscalYearEndMonth.description: The month the fiscal year ends for the association.

TaxInformation.description: The tax information of the association.

create_ownership_account_recurring_charg.title: Create a recurring charge
create_ownership_account_recurring_charg.description: Creates a recurring charge transaction that will post automatically on the specified ownership account ledger.
create_ownership_account_recurring_charg.notes: Buildium API key permission required: Associations > Ownership account transactions - View Edit. Permissions are set per key in Buildium's Settings > Developer tools, not carried as scopes.

gl_account_id.description: The general ledger account unique identifier under which the charge amount will be recorded. The general ledger account can only be an income or liability account.

amount.description: The amount to record when applying the charge to the lease ledger.

memo.description: Memo associated with the recurring charge. This value cannot exceed 65 characters.

first_occurrence_date.description: The date the charge will first be processed. This value along with the Frequency is also used as the basis for the date set on the transactions in future occurrences.

post_days_in_advance.description: Specifies the number of days ahead of the transaction date the charge will post on the lease ledger. This setting can be used to add the charge to the ledger ahead of the due date for visibility. For example, if the FirstOccurrenceDate is set to 8/10/2022 and this value is set to 5 then the charge will added to the ledger on 8/5/2022, but will have transaction date of 8/10/2022. Note, the value must be between 0 to 45 or set to 60, 75 or 90.

frequency.description: Specifies the frequency at which the recurring charge will be processed.

duration.description: Specifies the period of time/occurrences the recurring payment will be processed. Note, if the Frequency field is set to OneTime this field should be set to NULL as any submitted value will be ignored.

number_of_occurrences.description: Indicates the number of times the recurring transaction should be processed. This value is required if the Duration field is set to SpecificNumber. This value can not exceed 100.

output.description: The record: Id, OwnershipAccountId, GLAccountId, RentId, Amount, Memo, FirstOccurrenceDate, NextOccurrenceDate, PostDaysInAdvance, OccurrencesRemaining, Frequency, Duration.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the recurring charge schedule.

OwnershipAccountId.description: The unique identifier of the ownership account that the recurring charge will be applied to.

GLAccountId.description: The general ledger account unique identifier the recurring charge is applied to.

RentId.description: The unique identifier of the scheduled Rent entity. If the charge is not associated with a Rent entity then the value will be NULL.

Amount.description: The amount of the recurring charge.

Memo.description: Memo associated with the recurring charge.

FirstOccurrenceDate.description: The date the first occurence this charge was processed.

NextOccurrenceDate.description: The next date the scheduled charge will be processed.

PostDaysInAdvance.description: Specifies the number of days ahead of the transaction date the charge will post on the lease ledger. This setting can be used to add the charge to the ledger ahead of the due date for visibility.

OccurrencesRemaining.description: The number of remaining times this recurring charge will be processed.

Frequency.description: Indicates the frequency at which the recurring charge is processed.

Duration.description: Specifies the period of time/occurrences the recurring charge will be processed. Note, if the Frequency field is set to OneTime this field should be set to NULL as any submitted value will be ignored.

create_ownership_account_recurring_credi.title: Create a recurring credit
create_ownership_account_recurring_credi.description: Creates a recurring credit transaction that will post automatically on the specified ownership account ledger.
create_ownership_account_recurring_credi.notes: Buildium API key permission required: Associations > Ownership account transactions - View Edit. Permissions are set per key in Buildium's Settings > Developer tools, not carried as scopes.

credit_type.description: Indicates how the credit will be applied. WaiveUnpaid - This credit type allows for reversing one or more charges without losing record of what has changed.Exchange - This credit type allows for one of the following: 1) Reimburse a resident for a out-of-pocket expense, 2) Compensate for a service, 3) Write-off a resident balance considered uncollectable.PreviouslyDeposited - This credit type allows for issuing a credit against payments that have already been deposited.

offsetting_gl_account_id.description: Sets the offsetting general ledger account identifier for the credit. This value must be provided when the CreditType field is set to Exchange or PreviouslyDeposited. When the CreditType is Exchange this must be an *expense* general ledger account type. When the CreditType is PreviouslyDeposited this must be an *equity* general ledger account type.

posting_rule_gl_account_id.description: Indicates whether to apply a posting rule when processing the transaction that would only record the credit if a prior payment has been made. Set the field value to the Rent Income general ledger account identifier if the credit should only be recorded when a payment was made and applied to the Rent Income general ledger account. Set the field value to the Accounts Receivable general ledger account identifier if the credit should only be recorded when a payment was made and applied to *any* general ledger account. Set the field value to null to always record the credit.

lines.description: Line items describing how the credit is to be allocated when the recurring credit is processed. Each item: GLAccountId (integer, required); Amount (number, required).

post_days_in_advance.description: Specifies the number of days ahead of the transaction date the credit will post on the lease ledger. This setting can be used to add the credit to the ledger ahead of the due date for visibility. For example, if the FirstOccurrenceDate is set to 8/10/2022 and this value is set to 5 then the charge will added to the ledger on 8/5/2022, but will have transaction date of 8/10/2022. update_custom_field_definition.title: Update a custom field definition
update_custom_field_definition.description: Updates a custom field definition. For dropdown definitions, options are reconciled by id: options are added, their text is edited, or they are removed. Reordering existing options (changing their position without changing their text) is not supported and has no effect. The field type of a definition cannot be changed after creation, with one exception: a ShortText definition may be upgraded to LongText. When replacing the entire Configuration object, include its FieldType value to indicate which configuration shape is being provided. Required Permission(s):. Only the fields you send change; read the current values with get_custom_field_definition.

create_file_upload_request.title: Upload a file
create_file_upload_request.description: This is step 1 of 2: it saves the file metadata and returns UploadUrl, Headers and PhysicalFileName. Step 2, outside this API, is a PUT of the file binary to UploadUrl with Content-Type application/octet-stream plus the returned Headers, within 5 minutes, or the metadata is discarded. The file id is not returned; find it afterwards by filtering the matching file list on PhysicalFileName.

list_applicant_groups.notes: Buildium API key permission required: Rentals > Applicants - View. Permissions are set per key in Buildium's Settings > Developer tools, not carried as scopes. List filters (applicationgroupstatuses, unitids) are sent comma-joined in one query parameter; Buildium documents them as repeated parameters, so pass a single value per filter if a multi-value call is rejected.

entitytype.description: Filters results to any applicant groups associated with the specified entity identifier. This filter is used in conjunction with the EntityType field which must be set to the type of entity this identifier references.

entityid.description: Specifies the type of entity that EntityId refers to. This field is required if EntityId is specified.

applicationgroupstatuses.description: Filters results by the applicant group status. If no status is specified, applicant groups in any status will be returned.

unitids.description: Filters results to applicant groups associated to any of the specified rental property unit identifiers.

name.description: Filters results to applicant groups that includes applicants whose name *contains* the specified value.

orderby.description: orderby indicates the field(s) and direction to sort the results in the response. See Bulk Request Options for more information.

offset.description: offset indicates the position of the first record to return. The offset is zero-based and the default is 0.

limit.description: limit indicates the maximum number of results to be returned in the response. limit can range between 1 and 1000 and the default is 50.

output.description: A JSON array of records (the page selected by offset/limit; the X-Total-Count response header holds the full count). Each record carries Id, PropertyId, UnitId, ApplicationGroupStatus, Applicants.

update_applicant.title: Update an applicant
update_applicant.description: Updates an applicant. NOTE: Any field not included in the update request will be set to either an empty string or null in the database depending on the field definition. The recommended workflow to ensure no data is inadvertently overwritten is to execute a GET request for the resource you're about to update and then use this response to fill any of the fields that are not being updated. create_application_auto_allocated_paymen.description: Creates a payment on the application ledger. Note that the recorded payment will be automatically allocated to the general ledger accounts based on the payment allocation settings. These settings can be found under the Settings > Application Settings > Residents page in your account. This setting can be used to add the charge to the ledger ahead of the due date for visibility. For example, if the FirstOccurrenceDate is set to 8/10/2022 and this value is set to 5 then the charge will added to the ledger on 8/5/2022, but will have transaction date of 8/10/2022. Note, the value must be between 0 to 45 or set to 60, 75 or 90.

frequency.description: Specifies the frequency at which the recurring charge will be processed.

Permissions are set per key in Buildium's Settings > Developer tools, not carried as scopes.

lease_type.description: Describes the type of lease. AtWill leases are month-to-month leases. Setting a lease as at will tells Buildium when the tenant's lease initially started, but since there is no lease end date, Buildium will never move the lease to expired, and it will continue to post any automatic transactions (like recurring monthly rent charges or late fees) until you manually end the lease. Fixed leases are leases that have specific start and end dates.When the end date occurs, the lease will move from active to expired, and any transactions set to post automatically(like recurring monthly rent charges or late fees) will stop posting. FixedWithRollover leases are similar to fixed leases, but instead of Buildium moving this lease to expired as of the end date, it will move the lease to an at will status, which tells Buildium to continue posting monthly rent charges, late fees for you until you manually end the lease.

unit_id.description: Unit unique identifier associated with the lease.

Each item: FirstName (string, required); LastName (string, required); Email (string); AlternateEmail (string); PhoneNumbers (object) {Home (string); Work (string); Mobile (string); Fax (string)}; DateOfBirth (string); Comment (string); TaxId (string); EmergencyContact (object) {Name (string); RelationshipDescription (string); Phone (string); Email (string)}; Address (object, required) {AddressLine1 (string, required); AddressLine2 (string); AddressLine3 (string); City (string); State (string); PostalCode (string, required); Country (string, required, one of Afghanistan/Akrotiri/Albania/Algeria/AmericanSamoa/Andorra/Angola/Anguilla/Antarctica/AntiguaandBarbuda/...)}; AlternateAddress (object) {AddressLine1 (string, required); AddressLine2 (string); AddressLine3 (string); City (string); State (string); PostalCode (string, required); Country (string, required, one of Afghanistan/Akrotiri/Albania/Algeria/AmericanSamoa/Andorra/Angola/Anguilla/Antarctica/AntiguaandBarbuda/...)}; MailingPreference (string, one of PrimaryAddress/AlternateAddress).

tenant_ids.description: List of identifiers for existing tenants to add to the lease. The list cannot exceed five tenants.

applicant_ids.description: List of identifiers for applicants to become tenants on the lease. Identifiers must refer to applicants with a Status of Approved. The list cannot exceed five applicants.

list_rental_properties.notes: Buildium API key permission required: Rentals > Rental properties and units - View. Permissions are set per key in Buildium's Settings > Developer tools, not carried as scopes. List filters (types, subtypes, rentalownerids, propertyids) are sent comma-joined in one query parameter; Buildium documents them as repeated parameters, so pass a single value per filter if a multi-value call is rejected.

location.description: Filters results to only rental properties whose city or state *contains* the specified value.

types.description: Filters results by the rental type. If no type is provided all types will be returned.

subtypes.description: Filters results by the sub type of the rental property. If no sub type is specified all sub types will be returned.

status.description: Filters results by the status of the rental property. If no status is specified both active and inactive rental properties will be returned.

rentalownerids.description: Filters results to only rental properties whose RentalOwnerId matches the specified Id.

propertyids.description: Filters results to only rental properties units whose Rental matches the specified Id.

lastupdatedfrom.description: Filters results to any rental properties that were updated on or after the specified date. The value must be in UTC and formatted as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

lastupdatedto.description: Filters results to any rental properties that were updated on or before the specified date. The value must be in UTC and formatted as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

orderby.description: orderby indicates the field(s) and direction to sort the results in the response. See Bulk Request Options for more information.

offset.description: offset indicates the position of the first record to return. The offset is zero-based and the default is 0.

limit.description: limit indicates the maximum number of results to be returned in the response. limit can range between 1 and 1000 and the default is 50.

output.description: A JSON array of records (the page selected by offset/limit; the X-Total-Count response header holds the full count). isaccountcreated.description: Filters results to any users whose retail cash account is created.

orderby.description: orderby indicates the field(s) and direction to sort the results in the response. See Bulk Request Options for more information.

offset.description: offset indicates the position of the first record to return. The offset is zero-based and the default is 0.

limit.description: limit indicates the maximum number of results to be returned in the response. limit can range between 1 and 1000 and the default is 50.

output.description: A JSON array of records (the page selected by offset/limit; the X-Total-Count response header holds the full count). Each record carries UnitAgreement, User, Property, Unit, IsAccountCreated, IsEvictionPending, IsEnabled.

update_retail_cash_user.title: Update a retail cash user
update_retail_cash_user.description: Updates a retail cash user. A PUT replaces the record, so read it first with get_retail_cash_user and send every field you want to keep.
update_retail_cash_user.notes: Buildium API key permission required: Rentals > Tenants - View Edit OR Associations > Association owners and tenants - View Edit. Permissions are set per key in Buildium's Settings > Developer tools, not carried as scopes.

is_enabled.description: Whether retail cash is enabled for the user. If no retail cash account exists for the user, enabling will create one for the user. You cannot disable a user who does not have an account yet.

output.description: The record: UnitAgreement, User, Property, Unit, IsAccountCreated, IsEvictionPending, IsEnabled.

UnitAgreement.description: The unit agreement associated with the retail cash user.

User.description: The user data associated with the retail cash user.

Property.description: The property associated with the retail cash user.

Unit.description: The unit associated with the retail cash user.

IsAccountCreated.description: Whether the user has a retail cash account created.

IsEvictionPending.description: Whether the unit agreement associated with the retail cash user has a pending eviction.

IsEnabled.description: Whether retail cash is enabled for the user.
